articles.title: 10 Of Our Favorite Story-Driven VR Games Of All Time
articles.summary: Virtual Reality (VR) is highlighted as an exceptionally powerful medium for storytelling, especially appealing to gamers. Its key strength lies in its ability to deeply immerse users, placing them directly inside the game's world rather than just beside characters. This unparalleled immersion significantly enhances narrative engagement, offering a compelling and interactive way to experience stories that traditional gaming cannot replicate.
